jess-sales: FYI Hypersentinel just sent back the RFI, they want a capability matrix + full security questionnaire answered by EOD Thurs.

devon-eng: Copy. Do we have a current capability CSV for Dedicated vs Hosted? I can trim.

maria-sec: Quick q — does Hypersentinel require BYOK/HSM or is KMS OK? The questionnaire has a checkbox for FIPS 140-2 HSM and FedRAMP applicability.

jess-sales: They marked HSM as "preferred" but will accept KMS for POC. Legal flagged FedRAMP as a blocker if they need an attestation. 

rahul-pm: POC timeline: they want 2 weeks of perf tests. Do we have Dedicated reserve slots for that window? 

devon-eng: We can carve a Dedicated pool for 2 weeks but need commitment on throughput. Ask them for qps + max seq length. Also quantization profile preference?

jess-sales: I'll ask for QPS and seq. For pricing they asked for an example rate card for 100M tokens/month with burst to Dedicated. Any pre-built doc?

rahul-pm: Use the standard POCTiers spreadsheet under Sales Drive: 
```
Drive/Sales/POC_Tiers/poctiers_hypersentinel_v1.xlsx
```
I'll update with a cost scenario once devon confirms pool size.

maria-sec: On questionnaire — I'll own answers for network + auth + data residency. Need someone from infra to confirm VPC peering notes and egress costs. @devon-eng can you add the peering snippet?

devon-eng: Peering snippet added to the draft thread: <https://drive.redwood.com/sales/hypersentinel/rfi-draft.md>

jess-sales: Awesome. My plan: 1) ask Hypersentinel for QPS/seq + legal requirements 2) get devon to final capability CSV 3) maria to finish sec answers 4) rahul to publish pricing scenarios and POC SOW. 

ops-bot: Reminder: upload attachments by 1747200000 or the doc export will lose latest comments. :robot_face:

maria-sec: Heads up — FedRAMP answer depends on whether they require FedRAMP Moderate. If so, it's an enterprise legal lead convo; mark as potential blocker.

jess-sales: Noted. I'll triage after their reply. Anyone see any other blockers?

devon-eng: One more — HSM hardware in Private deployments needs lead time (2-3 weeks provisioning). Flag it in the RFI answers.

jess-sales: Good call. OK team, I'll ping them now and paste replies here. :thumbsup:
